content:
Hello # How did you find your way here? Well anyway, welcome to this little corner of the internet. I’m writing this at 2 AM after about four hours of sleep.
This site is a place to share my journey, thoughts, learning process, experiment, and occasional chaotic things with anyone who willing to read around my shenanigans. I got nothing much to share for now in this intro. Maybe this page will be updated whenever I have the time.
Note: Everything here reflects my personal views, does not represent any organization I’m connected to, and does not represent my employer view.
I’m open to suggestions and feedback. So, feel free to drop me a message on social media.
Thanks for stopping by and have a good trip ahead.

Education # Bachelor of Computer Science (Cybersecurity) Aug 2020 - Aug 2024 Universitas Bina Nusantara Experience # IT Security VAPT Specialist Jun 2024 - Dec 2025 VAPT End User Performed gray box and black box penetration testing across multiple platforms such as websites, API, mobile applications, desktop applications, and infrastructures. Create a local Active Directory environment with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and perform attack scenarios to assess detection readiness against malicious action. Conduct vulnerability assessment utilizing automated tools, evaluate findings, and report vulnerabilities utilizing a risk assessment template as an impact reference of risk. Coordinated with the Developer team to address the vulnerabilities found on applications by explaining the impact of findings based on risk and CVSS 4.0, and recommendations to fix vulnerabilities. Provide knowledge sharing on technical processes, documents, standards, and management-related to other team members. Cyber Security Intern Mar 2023 - Mar 2024 Cyber Security Consultant Conduct Penetration Testing of websites, API, infrastructure, and mobile applications using OWASP Web Security Testing Guide, OWASP Top 10, and OWASP Mobile Security Testing Guide Frameworks. Assist several assessments such as Risk Assessment and Zero Trust Assessment based on ISO 27001 and 27002. Utilized Kali Linux operating system and several tools such as Burp Suite to conduct penetration testing. Create a report with CVSS 3.1 scoring and recommendation to remediate based on engagement using Microsoft Office application. Create vulnerability management to track vulnerability using Microsoft Office application. Security+ Jan 2023 – Mar 2026 by CompTIA Learned basic cyber security concepts, threats, vulnerabilities, mitigations, security architectures, security operations, risk management, and compliance.
